content.$description: Default breathing-room inset of a content container: scrollable content area, sheet body. Use when a container needs its standard internal air and no more specific role applies.

group.$description: Internal inset of a grouped block: padding inside a visually bounded cluster (card interior, form group, grouped list). Wraps content that reads as one unit.

inline.$description: Horizontal rhythm along the reading direction (RTL-neutral). Pick by relationship between neighbors, not by desired size.

related.$description: Between elements of one conceptual group laid out in a row: fields of the same form row, buttons of one action set.

tight.$description: Between tightly coupled elements that read as a single unit in a row: icon and its label, control and its adjoining control, compact metadata items.

unrelated.$description: Between independent neighbors in a row: separate groups or unrelated controls sharing one line.

screen.$description: Horizontal padding from screen edge to body content. Defaults to the content inset; resolves independently per width class when tablet layouts arrive — same name, resolver context, never width-graded names.

ios.safeArea: Additive: apply inside the safe area (UIKit insetsLayoutMarginsFromSafeArea semantics). Full-width or floating elements that must clear hardware features use max(screen, safeArea) at the component level instead.

section.$description: Between major content regions of a screen: hero to body, one functional zone to the next. The largest rhythm step; if it feels insufficient, switch layout instead of scaling up.

stack.$description: Vertical rhythm along the block direction. Pick by relationship between neighbors, not by desired size.

related.$description: Between elements of one conceptual group stacked vertically: rows of the same form group, lines of one card body.

tight.$description: Between tightly coupled stacked elements that read as one unit: label above its value, helper text under its field, caption under an image.

unrelated.$description: Between independent groups stacked vertically: one form group to the next, card to unrelated card content.
